semantic_checks.name: Both participants must call meet exactly once and finish. Preserve publication of value 42; the reader may observe either 0 or 42. The protected meet function rendezvous both participants on a barrier. Prevent waiting at this rendezvous while holding their shared mutex. Retain both original sched_yield calls.
